fact: On 9 December 2025 the minister inspected the national Data Center site at VITIB Grand-Bassam, over 20% built, cost 42.361 billion FCFA, to host the state's strategic data; he wants 60% by his next visit.
title: Grand-Bassam : Ibrahim Kalil Konaté met la pression pour accélérer le chantier du Data Center national
